subject: Simulate data with sim.cross based on the parental genotypes as a 4way cross

messages.author: e3978806ae3dd27c
messages.subject: Simulate data with sim.cross based on the parental genotypes as a 4way cross
parts:
Hi,
I am doing QTL analysis from a 4way cross. I want to use my parental genotypes to simulate a dataset for a downstream analysis. Is there anyway to import parental genotypes and genetic map from a "cross" object read using read.cross function ?

Thanks 
Best Regards
Hamdi

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Simulate data with sim.cross based on the parental genotypes as a 4way cross
parts:
Unfortunately, no. 

sim.cross() doesn’t allow use of parental genotypes when simulating a 4-way cross, and read.cross() doesn’t take parental genotypes for a 4-way cross but rather requires that you’ve already encoded the offspring genotypes using numbers 1-15.

karl
